::: {.obsidian-press-kit}
:::

State who the organisation is and what it does. One paragraph that
a journalist can lift for a story.

# Company overview

Give the founding story, the mission, and the key facts. Include the
founding date and the head office location.

# Products and services

List the main products or services. One short paragraph each.

# Key executives

Name the senior team and their roles.

# Media assets

List the available assets: logos, imagery, and boilerplate. State
how to request them.

# Contact

State the media contact route.
